stemMarkdown: What is the overall average monthly salary across all employees in all three departments? (Round to 2 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: Total salary bill $= 3200000 + 1500000 + 675000 = 5375000$. Overall average $= 5375000 / 80 = 67187.5$. Note this weighted average is closer to Engineering's salary than a simple average of the three department averages would be, since Engineering has the most employees.
